name: Microsoft COCO
description: A large-scale benchmark for object detection, segmentation, and captioning with dense annotations across everyday scenes.
evaluation_method: mAP for detection, mask AP for segmentation, OKS-based AP for keypoints, and caption metrics such as CIDEr/BLEU depending on track
typical_sota_score: object detection AP typically around 60%+ on common tracks, depending on split and model family
notes: Widely used for multi-task vision research. Contains rich scene annotations and is a standard benchmark for detection and segmentation.
